name: Für Elise
comment: Both hands, the whole piece (105 bars, repeats not played twice; the first and second endings are bars 8 and 9, as on the sheet images). Notes are the right hand unless they say "hand": "L". One beat = an eighth note. The E-D# pickup is part of bar 1 (beats 1 and 1.5), so bar 1 is 4 beats long. beat = position in the bar (1 = first beat), beats = length (cut at the bar line), finger 1 = thumb ... 5 = little finger (only written for the opening). Converted from a MIDI file (tracks "up:" and "down:"). tempoBpm is a practice tempo in eighth notes; the MIDI itself plays at 144. Edit fingers or hints here, no code change needed.
